definition: The accepted measurement roots of the systematic-uncertainty envelope. Each entry names one commit-scoped result root, the measurement receipt inside it, and that receipt's sha256. This file holds no physics value and decides no physics question. It states which already-accepted artifacts a newer commit may read.
authority: Ruling R7's fail-closed frame, and the architect-verified envelope probe of 2026-08-25. PRACTICE section 4 makes a result root commit-scoped and forbids overwriting an accepted one. The probe measured every hash below from the artifact on the Nikhef cluster; the 2026-08-22 executive handoff carries the same six values from an independent measurement.
why_a_pin_and_not_a_rerun: An accepted result is immutable under its own commit root. A newer commit never regenerates it to satisfy a newer path, because a regenerated result is a different measurement wearing an accepted name. A newer commit references the accepted root by digest instead, and this file is that reference.
resolution_order: tools/systematics_request.py resolves each measurement input in one order: the current commit root first, then the entry below, then a refusal that names the campaign and this file. A campaign with no entry refuses. A pinned receipt whose measured sha256 differs from the value below refuses. No tool writes into a root named here.
path_rule: Every path below is relative to HADRONIZATION_RESULTS_ROOT. The site prefix stays out of this file: a tracked absolute path would freeze one cluster's layout into the repository.
variation_boundary_receipt_path: plots/multiplicity_boundary_receipt_v2.json, relative to the measurement directory. Ruling R10 makes every variation re-derive its own class boundaries, so each accepted root carries its own boundary receipt. tools/systematics_envelope.py measures that file and records its sha256 in the envelope's provenance.

nominal.reason: The accepted nominal render. The envelope binds to the class edges this receipt records, so an envelope built against another render would sit on other classes.

declared_absent.HF_SYS_PTHAT_1: Ruling R9 excludes this arm from the per-class envelope. Its measurement receipt exists under the same accepted root and reports completion_status FAIL. No pin is declared, because a pin here would offer the envelope an input the owner ruled out.
